tagline: Explore your city and discover original creatures.
safety: Play safe: watch your surroundings and never enter private property.
offline: Cannot reach the server. Try again in a moment.
ageHint: We only keep your age band, never your date of birth.
ageRestricted: Sorry, you are not old enough to play yet.
linkSent: If the email is right, a link is on its way. It expires in 15 minutes.
saveHint: You are a guest. Add an email so you keep your progress if you change phones.
verifyFailed: The link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
emailTaken: That email already belongs to another account.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure? Your account and collection will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
reauth: For your security, sign in again with your email and retry.
guestLogoutWarning: You are a guest: signing out loses your progress.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
evolveHold: after {{days}} days in your collection without trading it
locationWhy: nyrgo uses your location only while you play, to show what is nearby. Exact positions are deleted after 24 hours.
locationDenied: We do not have permission to see your location. Allow it in your browser settings to play.
locationUnavailable: We could not get your location. Step outside and try again.
weakSignal: Weak GPS signal ({{m}} m). Waiting for a better fix…
drivingWarning: Looks like you are in a vehicle. Never play while driving.
mockNotice: Your phone says this location is simulated. Close any fake-location app: the game pauses for a few minutes.
cooldownNotice: Your location jumped suddenly. To be safe, interactions come back in {{min}} min.
mapLabel: Map with your position and nearby places
nearbyEmpty: Nothing around you yet. Try walking towards a square or a park.
reportConfirm: Report this place as unsafe or private? It will be hidden if several players report it.
creaturesEmpty: No creatures in sight. Walk a little: they change every 15 minutes.
areaLoading: Exploring this area for the first time… Creatures will appear in a minute or two.
resultEscaped: {{name}} broke out of the vault. Try again.
noVaults: You are out of vaults. Soon you will find more at nearby places.

nft.confirm:
{{name}} will go to your wallet {{account}} as an NFT (test network).

It stays with you in the game while you hold the NFT. If you give it away or sell it, it goes to whoever holds it. While it is an NFT it cannot evolve.
nft.minted: {{name}} is now an NFT in your wallet {{account}}.
nft.gradeHint: Grade from its individual values: D, C, B, A and S (the best and scarcest).

social.title: Friends
social.why: Add friends with their code, in person. They only see your name, level and creatures; never where you are.
social.requested: Request sent. You will be friends once they accept.
social.noFriends: No friends here yet. Share your code with someone next to you.
social.tradeHint: One for one. To close it, both of you must be within 100 m with the map open. The offer expires in 10 minutes.
social.proposed: Offer sent to {{name}}. They accept it while you are together.
social.traded: Trade done! Your new creature is in your collection.
social.tradesWhy: Trades happen face to face: both with the map open and within 100 m. Up to 5 a day.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.barLabel: {{main}} XP from exploring and {{hub}} XP from the town, of {{need}} for the next level
progress.waiting: You have {{xp}} town XP waiting: it counts once you earn as much exploring.
progress.rule: The town counts for at most {{share}} % of your progress; the rest comes from walking and catching.
progress.companion: Creature that follows you in town
progress.companionAuto: Automatic (your starter or your highest level)
progress.companionSaved: Done: it will follow you next time you enter the town.

hub.enterText: Meet other explorers, chat and show off your look and your creatures.
hub.title: Town Square
hub.canvasLabel: The town square, with the players around you
hub.chatAdult: You are chatting with adult players. Never share contact details.
hub.chatMinor: You are chatting with players under 18 only. Never share contact details.

gym.name: Gym
gym.text: Train your creatures against coaches, with daily challenges.

arena.name: Arena
arena.text: Casual and ranked battles against other players, and seasonal rankings.

market.name: Market
market.text: Buy and sell outfits, decorations and materials with Gold.

house.name: House
house.text: Buy a house, decorate it and invite your friends.

guide.name: Ivy, the guide
guide.text: Welcome to town! Here you meet other explorers. Walk with the stick or the arrow keys, say hi with an emote, and use the portal to go back to the map: the real adventure is still out there, walking.

merchant.name: Mira, the merchant
merchant.text: My market opens soon. Meanwhile, the cosmetics shop is in your profile: dress your explorer and everyone here will see it.

hub.exitText: You will leave the town and return to exploring.

reason.personal_info: Asking for or sharing personal details

hub.reported: Thanks. A moderator will review it.
hub.blocked: Blocked. You will not see each other in town.

err.house_closed: That house is closed to you.
err.chat_link: Links are not allowed in chat.
err.chat_contact: Contact details are not allowed in chat, for everyone’s safety.
err.chat_muted: Your chat is paused for now by a moderator.

wardrobe.title: Your explorer
wardrobe.why: This is how you look on the map. Try anything on and buy what you like with Gold; cosmetics change nothing in the game.
wardrobe.bought: {{name}} is yours. Save to wear it.
wardrobe.tryingOn: You are trying it on: buy it to be able to save.
wardrobe.saved: Look saved! This is how you will look on the map.
wardrobe.holderNote: Holder outfits are for test token holders from rank 3 (0.5 %) up. You can try them on here; saving one needs the rank.

gym.why: Pick a creature and a difficulty: the coach answers with one of theirs. Every bout teaches your creature something, and wins pay town XP. Up to {{n}} a day.
gym.doneToday: That is all the training for today. Come back tomorrow, or go out and explore.
gym.noCreatures: You need a creature first: catch one on the map.

arena.why: Ranked battles pit your creature against another explorer’s defender, matched by rating. Practice battles count for nothing: try freely.
arena.defenderWhy: Other explorers fight this creature when they challenge you. You do not need to be online.
arena.boardEmpty: Nobody has fought a ranked battle yet. Be the first!

townMarket.empty: Nothing for sale right now. Come back later, or sell something yourself.
townMarket.youGet: You get {{gold}} Gold ({{pct}} % fee: {{fee}}). On sale for {{hours}} h; unsold items come back.
townMarket.listed: On sale. You get the Gold when someone buys it.
townMarket.nothingToSell: You have no items to sell.
townMarket.withdrawn: Withdrawn: the items are back in your bag.
townMarket.furnitureWhy: Furniture for your house. Place it from inside your house.
townMarket.boughtFurniture: {{item}} is yours. Go home to place it.

house.title: Houses
house.why: Every explorer has a house. Visit yours to decorate it, or a friend’s if their door is open.
house.noFriends: No friends’ houses open to you yet.
house.placeHow: Walk to where you want it, then press “Place here”.
house.nothingToPlace: Nothing left to place. Mira, on the square, sells furniture.
house.badSpot: It does not fit there. Stand on open floor.

board.why: Three small jobs a day around town. They pay Gold and town XP (which counts as far as the 50 % rule allows).

quest.market_list: Put something on sale at the market
quest.place_furniture: Place {{n}} pieces of furniture at home
quest.tournament_join: Sign up for the weekly tournament

first_purchase.name: Shopper
first_purchase.text: Buy a lot at the market.

cosy_home.name: Cosy home
cosy_home.text: Have {{n}} pieces of furniture at home.

season_top10.name: Top ten
season_top10.text: Finish a season in the top {{n}}.

tournament.why: Every week, {{when}}: a knockout tournament with the creature you choose (at least {{min}} explorers). Prizes: {{first}} Gold for the winner, {{second}} for the runner-up and {{third}} for each semi-finalist.
tournament.in: You are in. It is played {{when}}; come back to see the bracket.

lb.title: Leaderboards
lb.notYet: You are not on this board yet.

globe.label: Show my catches on the world map at nyrgo.fun
globe.why: Only the rough area (about 50 km), an hour later, with your name hidden (A****). Turning it off removes the marks already shown.
globe.savedOn: Your next catches will appear on the world map.
globe.savedOff: Done: your catches are off the world map, and the marks already shown were deleted.

duel.title: Friendly duels
duel.why: Challenge a friend with one of your creatures. They answer with one of theirs when you are within 100 m, and the game fights it out. Creatures fight at full health and nobody loses anything. Up to 10 a day.
duel.hint: The challenge expires in 10 minutes. Your friend accepts it standing next to you, with the map open.
duel.sent: Challenge sent to {{name}}. They accept it while you are together.

tips.title: NEAR tips
tips.why: Walk to a creature and catch it: you earn {{amount}} NEAR, paid from the market fees. At most one per hour, {{distance}} m or more from the last one, and {{max}} a day. Test network ({{network}}): no real money.
tips.won: +{{amount}} NEAR tip! It reaches your wallet within a minute.

no.no_wallet: Link your NEAR wallet in your profile to earn NEAR tips.
no.too_soon: No tip this time: one per hour at most.
no.too_close: No tip: walk at least 100 m from where you earned the last one.
no.daily_limit: You have earned all of today’s tips.
no.pool_empty: Today’s pot is used up. There will be more tomorrow.
no.under_review: Your account is under review; tips are paused.
no.not_verified: NEAR tips are only earned in the verified Android app.

market.title: Market
market.why: Buy and sell creature NFTs with your wallet. {{fee}} % of each sale (and {{royalty}} % of resales on other markets) goes to the pot that pays the tips.
market.empty: No creatures for sale right now.
market.buyConfirm: Buy {{name}} for {{price}} NEAR? You will sign it in your wallet.
market.bought: You bought {{name}}. It will appear in your collection in a few seconds.
market.badPrice: Enter a price in NEAR (at least 0.01).
market.sellConfirm: Put {{name}} on sale for {{price}} NEAR? Your wallet will ask for a 0.01 NEAR deposit, returned when the sale ends.
market.failed: It did not go through. Nothing was moved.

near.title: NEAR wallet
near.why: Link your NEAR account for the web3 features coming later. For now it is a test network: no real money.
near.safety: You only sign a message. nyrGo! will never ask for your seed phrase or private keys, and it sends no transactions.
near.failed: That did not work. Try again.

errors.quest_not_done: Not finished yet, or already collected.
errors.tournament_closed: Sign-ups are closed for this tournament.
errors.listing_gone: That sale is no longer available.
errors.listing_limit: You have too many things on sale. Wait or withdraw one.
errors.house_closed: That house is closed to you.
errors.hub_limit: That is the limit for today.
errors.no_opponent: Nobody to fight in your range right now. Try practice, or later.
errors.friend_limit: You have reached the limit of friends or requests for today.
errors.friend_age_mismatch: You cannot be friends in the game because of your ages.
errors.not_friends: You can only trade with friends.
errors.trade_too_far: You must be within 100 m, both with the map open.
errors.trade_limit: The daily trade limit has been reached.
errors.duel_limit: The daily duel limit has been reached.
errors.trade_unavailable: One of those creatures cannot be traded any more.
errors.too_far: You are too far. Get within 40 m.
errors.out_of_items: You have no vaults of that kind left.
errors.cooldown_active: Interactions are paused for a moment.
errors.speed_implausible: You are moving too fast to interact.
errors.location_required: We need your current position. Wait for the GPS.
errors.network: No connection. Try again: no extra vault will be spent.
errors.other: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.already_won: Already worn out: try to capture it.
errors.not_ready: The conditions are not met yet.
errors.web3_restricted: Wallets are for players aged 18 or over.
errors.wallet_challenge_invalid: The signing request expired or was already used. Try again.
errors.wallet_signature_invalid: The signature does not match. Try again from your wallet.
errors.wallet_key_not_full_access: Sign with the NEAR account itself, not another app’s key.
errors.wallet_unavailable: NEAR could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.wallet_required: Link your NEAR account in the Profile first.
errors.attest_required: Open nyrGo! in the Android app to verify your device.
errors.creature_onchain: This creature is an NFT: it cannot evolve or be sent again.
errors.nft_unavailable: NEAR could not be reached. Your creature is still in the game; try again.

starterWhy: It will be with you from the start. You can only pick one.
visitCooldown: You visited it recently. Come back in a few minutes.
evolveConfirm: Evolve {{from}} into {{to}}? The Gold and materials will be spent.
offlineBanner: No connection. The Dex and your collection still work; the rest returns when you are back online.

steps.title: First steps
steps.starter: Pick your first creature in Collection
steps.location: Turn on your location on the map
steps.approach: Get within 40 m of a creature
steps.catch: Throw a vault and catch it
steps.visit: Visit a nearby place to find items
steps.skip: I know how to play, hide this

admin.title: Administration
admin.reason: Reason for the next action (required, recorded)
admin.reasonRequired: Write a reason of at least 5 characters.
admin.noSignals: No signals in the last 7 days

events.title: Events
events.adminOnly: Only the admin role can create or cancel events.
events.none: No events in the last 7 days.
events.hint: The creature appears at the place for everyone, at this level. Write the reason above: it goes in the log.

noFighters: None of your creatures can battle right now. They rest on their own: 10 % HP every 5 minutes.
foeWorn: {{name}} is worn out: now much easier to capture.
foeHurt: {{name}} is hurt ({{hp}} of {{max}} HP): easier to capture.

battle.title: Battle against {{name}}

result.win: You wore {{name}} out! It will now be much easier to capture.
result.loss: Your creature ran out of strength.

battle.capReached: You reached today’s limit of battle rewards.

chest.title: Your first nyrGo
chest.tap: Tap the chest to open it
chest.sure: {{name}} will be with you from the start. This can't be changed.
chest.failed: It could not be saved. Try again.

holder.title: {{symbol}} token (testnet)
holder.why: A test token with no value, on NEAR {{network}}. Keep it in your linked NEAR account: your rank counts the smallest balance of the last {{hours}} hours, so a rank starts {{hours}} hours after you reach it.
holder.noAccount: Link a NEAR account above to get a rank.
holder.next: {{rank}} counts from {{when}} if you keep the tokens until then.
holder.stale: Balances have not been read for a while; ranks pause until they are.
holder.note: The NEAR boost comes out of the same daily reward pot (at most a quarter of it); when that share is used up, tips are paid without the boost. Testnet only: nothing here has value.

sheet.chanceNote: From a plain throw to a perfect one, with the creature unhurt. Weakening it in a battle first raises the chance up to twice as much.
sheet.flee: After a missed throw it runs away {{pct}} of the time.

tg.how: Tap to charge the vault and keep the energy inside the glowing band: the fuller the ring around the vault, the better the throw.
